summary.tldr: Requires the Minister of Finance to develop and report on a national framework for a guaranteed livable basic income for people over 17 in Canada.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Finance to develop a national framework for a guaranteed livable basic income program across Canada for anyone over 17.
Requires the minister to consult federal and provincial ministers, Indigenous Elders and governing bodies, and other stakeholders and experts when developing the framework.
Requires the framework to set regional measures for what counts as a livable basic income, based on needed goods and services and local costs.
Requires national standards for health and social supports that work with the program in each province.
Requires the framework to make education, training or work participation optional, and to protect existing health or disability supports from being reduced.
Requires a report on the framework within one year, publication on the Department of Finance website, and yearly review reports after that.
who_it_affects: People with health or disability needs
Ministers responsible for health, housing and employment
